objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
.github/workflows/tests.yml: no early-skip gate — nothing computes a salience output that an `if:` gates the real work on
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pr/push workflow got a deliberate, justified trigger decision and the required `unit-tests` check correctly avoided both cap conditions (no workflow-level path filter, no duplicate check name), though the agent stopped at 'fully unfiltered' and never implemented the ideal internal computed-output `if:` gating that would give doc-only PRs a salient fast pass while still reporting the check.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: The deploy and docs-site path lists are genuinely derived from what each workflow's own steps consume (deploy.sh's packaged inputs; mkdocs build's docs/mkdocs.yml), are distinct rather than sibling copies, and correctly include each workflow file itself.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only (nightly-sweep) and issue-driven (triage) workflows, the branch-protection ruleset, and tests.yml were all left untouched, with edits confined strictly to the two workflows that warranted path filters.
